purpose: PLAN_M5 M5.4b rt_water_ls_shadows (local lights) at S8 Water Queens House: geometry and reflections on throughout, compose and sun shadows off (isolates the local-light visibility), rt_water_ls_shadows=1 at launch so the water FS are patched with the sun and local-light words (96-B records), toggled live. The audited water FS shadow only lights with a game shadow map (atlas); ON walks the FS's own froxel list (its set 2 light buffers, captured at the water draw), checks the recomputed per-light sum against the FS's recorded point + spot sum, and removes F c_k of each unshadowed light whose traced ray is occluded: C' = max(C - F sum (1 - V_k) c_k, 0). A 15 s precheck with the key on (its [water] local shadows line needs local records and checked records, else INVALID: a view without local light on the water), then OFF / ON / OFF with diag-off cost windows and one PNG each, and the view (rt_debug 27: red occluded, green lit, dark magenta only shadow-mapped lights, blue unknown, white sum check beyond 10%). Gates: sum check within 0.098% for at least 99% of checked records (the half precision of the record; the FS model test 4g has 100%), ratio of the means 1 within 0.1%; shot-off-a vs shot-off-b within the OFF repeat noise; shot-on darker than OFF only on water pixels the view marks red, never brighter; [water] local shadows GPU median (ON minus OFF of the compose GPU line) against the < 0.15 ms estimate and cost-on minus cost-off against the OFF spread.
